title: Chandler, AZ — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Chandler, AZ: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Chandler is a city in AZ with a population of 280,711. Phoenix tech suburb with Intel, excellent schools, and 296 days of sunshine. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 9b growing zone supports Warm to hot — citrus, tropical fruits, year-round growing. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 296 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
